#### The average hourly count of bike rentals

The [`Bikeshare` data](#sec-bikeshare-lab) count the bikes rented in each of many hours, as `bikers`.
A first look at a count [outcome](model-validation.qmd#def-outcome-vector) starts with its typical size.

::: {.callout-tip}

#### Hint

`mean()` in R and the pandas `.mean()` method in Python compute a [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean).

:::

Compute the [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) of `bikers`.
